firstImpression: 上半纸面粗蜡笔邀请字，右真人与左大头玩偶并肩，底部纸上再次画出同一玩偶
primaryMechanism: 同一主题物在左上手绘预告、左下实体、右下纸页画稿三次出现，真人提供现实入口
primaryFocus: 上半不规则黑色手绘主标题，其次是真人脸与玩偶大脸
dominantAxis: 左上小画到上方标题再折向右真人、左下主题物、右下纸页的松散Z形

zones.align: right anchored; face toward upper left
left foreground, bleed left and bottom
diagonal open paper, cut by lower edge

negativeSpace: between glyphs; do not fill with microcopy
readingPath: bottom open sketchbook and matching drawing

typography.mainTitle: two-level loose hand-lettered thick black wax-crayon Chinese; blunt broken ends, dry paper skips, irregular baseline and tracking; no outline, shadow or 3D

colorRoles.primaryText: near-black matte crayon high contrast; included in dark 32-40%
colorRoles.subjectSupport: natural warm skin and brown object face 9-14%
colorRoles.darkGround: near-black or deep brown table and object outline; included in dark 32-40%
colorRoles.contrastCheck: main letters readable at 360 px without outline; book separated from table

materialEffects: dry wax-crayon grain inside letter strokes
warm mottled paper or plaster backdrop
natural soft front light on real person
light contact shadows at paper and hand
locked: small drawing and large foreground object depict same subject
bottom dark table with open thematic sketchbook
